scenes.text: Your phone battery could lift you {c_m} m
scenes.narration: Your phone battery holds enough energy to lift you {c_m_say} meters.
Five thousand milliamp hours at three point eight five volts is nineteen watt hours. That's {c_j_say} joules. Lifting seventy kilos, that's {c_m_say} meters.
That's a {c_floors} floor building. In theory, with zero losses.
Charge it tonight with that in mind.
